01 Profile

Curiosity, made practical.

I follow difficult questions all the way to working systems.

My work sits between mathematical reasoning and implementation. I’m especially interested in how quantum computation moves from theory into reliable software, accessible platforms, and real-world scientific workflows.

I bring a physics-first perspective, a programmer’s appetite for problem solving, and an infrastructure mindset. Whether I’m exploring a quantum algorithm, tracing a graph, containerizing a service, or designing a cloud workflow, I care about making complex systems legible and useful.
